text:
lina: Quick UX/infra q: when a user pivots from Route -> Model in Console analytics, should we carry over the active filters & saved query, or reset to a model-first palette?

josh: I think carry over time range + query text + model tags. Route-specific pins (region, capacity tier, rollout groups) should be explicitly decoupled. Preserving context reduces surprise.

rachel: +1 on time range. Also we need to show clearly if quota/preview cost shown was route-scoped and is now stale. A small badge: "cost preview (route-only)" that becomes a hint in model view.

diego: For saved queries we currently only store scope = ["route","model","global"]. That seems OK but we should expose which scopes match at runtime so UI can show "This saved query matches: route, global". Don't change API shape if avoidable.

zoe: Maybe client side can compute match: saved_query.filters contains predicates, UI evaluates whether those predicates are applicable in target scope. If some predicates aren't supported in model view we'll gray them out and show "removed X predicates". Telemetry: log analytics.filter_prune { pruned_count, pruned_keys } for later analysis.

josh: Agree. We should also emit analytics.saved_query_applied with origin enum (route|model|global) and applied_predicate_count. That helps measure discoverability.

lina: Good point. Also, what happens for cross-scope combined views (e.g., you open /console/route/photos?model=mosaic-v2)? Which saved queries do we surface?

rachel: Show in order: exact route-scoped > route+model scoped (if we ever add) > model-scoped > global. But we need a compact UI: show top 3 matches and a "See all". Each item should have scope chips.

diego: UX nit: the chips should be tappable to filter the saved list by scope. Implementation note: avoid adding new server endpoints; just fetch saved queries once and client-side filter.

zoe: Edge-case: rollouts. If a saved query includes rollout:variant=canary we must not silently apply that on model tab. Proposal: when switching scopes, keep rollout predicates but show them as "inactive (route only)" and exclude them from query. Clicking the chip will open the route tab and reapply the full saved query.

josh: For deep-links, reuse existing pattern: /console/route/{id}?filters={encoded}&t={time}. We should add /console/model/{modelId}?filters=... for parity. If user clicks the banner "Open in route" it should encode the exact set of predicates the user had, including rollouts.

lina: Minimal API changes we might need: none for saved queries. For telemetry add two events: analytics.saved_query_applied { saved_query_id, origin, applied_count } and analytics.filter_pruned { reason: "unsupported_in_scope"|"rollout_inactive", pruned_count }.

rachel: Copy suggestions: Banner in model view: "Some filters from the route view are not active here (rollouts, region pins). \nClick \"Open route\" to compare with the same filters." Tooltip on pruned predicate: "This filter is route-scoped and is disabled in model view."

diego: I'll file infra ticket to reserve telemetry namespace and add kinesis schema: infra#4620. Zoe will add unit tests that assert pruned_count is emitted.

zoe: I'll sketch UI states: preserved-full, preserved-with-prune, fresh-model. Also small animation when toggling so users notice difference.

infra-bot: Heads-up: Console canary deploy scheduled 2026-03-23 07:30 PT under flag preserve-filter-pivot. Opt-out by replying to this thread.

lina: Plan of record: Zoe prototype labels & animations; Josh add analytics events; Diego file infra ticket & deep-link codemap; Rachel produce copy; Lina will write a short RFC capturing the non-breaking API stance and rollouts handling. We'll reconvene after prototypes land.

josh: I'll also add a tiny backend lint to saved_query ingestion to reject unsupported predicate keys (with a warning) so the client can rely on a known whitelist.

lina: Thanks everyone, I'll drop the RFC link here when ready.

zoe: One more ask: add a small audit metric showing % of saved queries that include route-only predicates so we can prioritize adding first-class model equivalents.

lina: Noted. Adding to RFC.

infra-bot: Canary deployed (flag active) — monitor dashboards for increased filter_pruned events.

lina: Closing here, will follow up with RFC + design mockups.
